id: title:Gilbert09:clamp out of range dates instead of crashing the sync

review.posthog_relevance: Redshift warehouse ingestion and data integrity
review.reason: Adds SafeDateLoader to psycopg connection adapters, registering it globally for RedshiftImplementation. P1.F1.H3 and P1.F1.H4 show the implementation of SafeDateLoader and its registration, preventing psycopg's default DateLoader from raising DataError on out-of-range dates and clamping values instead. P1.F2.H3 adds unit tests for out-of-range and unparseable inputs. This prevents,
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of Redshift warehouse ingestion and psycopg's default DateLoader behavior, which are not independently verified in this chunk. The score assumes the warehouse ingestion path is active and that psycopg's default behavior is the relevant failure mode. No adoption or incident avoidance is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are independently verified; only the implementation and its tests are observed.

observations.behavior: Adds SafeDateLoader class and registers it as the date adapter loader for psycopg connections.
observations.posthog_connection: Redshift warehouse ingestion: psycopg's default DateLoader raises DataError on dates outside Python's supported range, potentially aborting warehouse syncs. This implementation clamps out-of-range values to date.min/date.max and raises ValueError for unparseable input, preventing silent corruption.

observations.behavior: Registers SafeDateLoader with the database connection.
observations.posthog_connection: Applies the safe loader globally to every warehouse connection established by RedshiftImplementation.

observations.behavior: Adds SafeDateLoader to the list of exported symbols and imports date in the main module.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds unit tests for SafeDateLoader, including cases for out-of-range dates and unparseable input, and a guard test ensuring the loader is registered on every connection.
